records.summary: A physically grounded camera-control framework for scene-consistent changes in focal length and viewpoint during image synthesis.

records.summary: A multimodal world model that jointly controls ego motion, object dynamics, and scene composition across domains.

records.title: From One to More: Contextual Part Latents for 3D Generation

records.title: Focus-N-Fix: Region-Aware Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Image Generation

records.title: Fluid: Scaling Autoregressive Text-to-image Generative Models with Continuous Tokens

records.title: EgoControl: Controllable Egocentric Video Generation via 3D Full-Body Poses

records.title: DynamicCity: Large-Scale 4D Occupancy Generation from Dynamic Scenes
records.summary: An occupancy-generation framework for large-scale dynamic urban scenes with strong 4D structural priors.

records.title: DrivingSphere: Building a High-fidelity 4D World for Closed-loop Simulation
records.summary: Builds a realistic 4D world and visual synthesis stack for closed-loop autonomous-driving simulation.

records.title: DriveScape: Towards High-Resolution Controllable Multi-View Driving Video Generation
records.summary: A high-resolution multi-view driving video generator with strong spatial-temporal alignment under sparse 3D control.

records.title: DisCo-Layout: Disentangling and Coordinating Semantic and Physical Refinement in a Multi-Agent Framework for 3D Indoor Layout Synthesis
records.summary: Uses coordinated semantic and physical refinement tools inside a multi-agent loop for indoor layout synthesis.

records.title: Direct Numerical Layout Generation for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Spatial Reasoning

records.title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
records.summary: Shows that a diffusion model can function as a real-time neural game engine over long interactive rollouts.

records.title: Denoising Autoregressive Transformers for Scalable Text-to-Image Generation
records.summary: DART unifies autoregressive generation and denoising ideas for scalable image synthesis.

records.title: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI
records.summary: NVIDIA’s open world foundation model platform spanning tokenizers, pretrained models, and post-training recipes for physical AI.

records.title: CoGen: 3D Consistent Video Generation via Adaptive Conditioning for Autonomous Driving
records.summary: Improves 3D consistency in controllable driving video generation through spatially adaptive 3D conditions.

records.title: Causal Reasoning Elicits Controllable 3D Scene Generation
records.summary: Injects causal graphs and interventions into scene generation for stronger logical and physical coherence.

records.title: Bolt3D: Generating 3D Scenes in Seconds

records.summary: A single-image avatar generator that targets animation-ready humans with strong local detail and consistent 3D structure.

records.summary: A training-free parallel decoding algorithm for accelerating autoregressive image generation without sacrificing diversity.

records.title: 3D-GPT: Procedural 3D Modeling with Large Language Models
records.summary: An early but still relevant LLM-driven procedural 3D modeling framework for scene and asset construction.

records.summary: Treats point-cloud generation as progressive next-scale up-sampling rather than flat-token prediction.

records.title: FLUX.1: Scalable Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
records.summary: A highly influential rectified-flow image generator that remained one of the dominant open ecosystems throughout 2025.

records.title: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework for Large Video Generation Models
records.summary: A major open video backbone that remained highly active and widely reused throughout 2025.

records.title: TripoSR: Fast 3D Object Reconstruction from a Single Image
records.summary: A fast feed-forward single-image 3D reconstruction model that remained actively used in 2025 pipelines and baselines.

records.title: InstantMesh: Efficient 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image with Sparse-view Large Reconstruction Models
records.summary: A highly practical single-image mesh generator that continued to be heavily used in 2025 open workflows.

records.title: PixArt-Sigma: Weak-to-Strong Training of Diffusion Transformer for 4K Text-to-Image Generation
records.summary: An important open DiT baseline that continued to matter in 2025 as a widely reused high-resolution training recipe.

records.title: Waymax: An Accelerated, Data-Driven Simulator for Large-Scale Autonomous Driving Research
records.summary: A widely used large-scale autonomous-driving simulator that remained actively relevant throughout 2025 evaluation workflows.

records.title: Era3D: High-Resolution Multiview Diffusion using Efficient Row-wise Attention
records.summary: A multiview generation model that remained relevant in 2025 for single-image 3D asset pipelines.

records.title: RGB2Point: 3D Point Cloud Generation from Single RGB Images
records.summary: A transformer-based single-image point-cloud generator that stayed useful in 2025 as a strong lightweight baseline.

records.title: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer
records.summary: An influential open T2V backbone that continued to be actively reused in 2025 research and engineering.

records.title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
records.summary: VectorWorld is a streaming autonomous-driving world model that incrementally generates ego-centric lane-agent vector-graph tiles during rollout. It uses a motion-aware VAE and one-step masked completion on vector graphs to achieve stable, real-time long-horizon simulation. The work is valuable because it targets policy-compatible closed-loop generation instead of offline video-only realism.
